messages:
elaine: Quick sync: finance found a customer dispute where a streaming request that retried during router preemption resulted in both a provisional and a final ledger line being billed. Customer sees two lines and complains of being double-charged.

mike: Can you paste the minimal log and route details?

elaine: model=rwd-2b, route=us-central-fallback. Logs: `2026-07-12T10:21:01Z stream.start sid=abc123 seq=0`, `2026-07-12T10:21:02Z router.handoff from=shard-5 to=shard-12`, `2026-07-12T10:21:02Z toolcall.ack seq=25 client_eof=true truncated=true`, `2026-07-12T10:21:03Z ledger.emit provisional id=pv-211 tokens=140`, `2026-07-12T10:21:04Z ledger.emit final id=fn-212 tokens=64 confirmed=true`

david: If final exists and is smaller, customer should end up billed for final. Looks like tombstone didn't mark pv-211 stale. Do we currently emit tombstones on truncate?

mike: No durable handoff id today; routers use ephemeral claims. Tombstone logic exists in runtime but ties to in-memory claim ids; if claim id changes on reconnect, ledger can't correlate.

elaine: Product ask: add an explicit durable header `x-handoff` (UUID) that is created once per logical request and carried across reconnects and child requests. Ledger rows would include it, making grouping trivial.

frank: Ledger design question: tombstone as separate row vs marking `provisional.state=stale`? I prefer tombstone row for auditability.

david: Agreed. Tombstone row fields: `hand_off`, `prev_row_id`, `prev_tokens`, `last_ack_seq`, `emitted_at`. Also add `ledger.tombstone.count` metric.

mike: Runtime notes: when a new shard takes over and receives `truncated=true`, it should emit tombstone referencing old provisional row if handoff matches. But we need CAS semantics on ledger to avoid confirm/tombstone races. Propose ledger write semantics: writes keyed by `handoff` with conditional check on `version`.

elaine: Console changes: group rows by `x-handoff` by default; collapsed view shows authoritative token count (prefer final if present). Add a small timeline widget with entries: provisional -> tombstone (if emitted) -> final. Also add help text explaining provisional semantics.

frank: Metrics/alerts: `billing.duplicate_sessions` (sessions with >1 active charge after 1m), `ledger.tombstone.latency_ms`. Alert if duplicate_sessions > 2/min on a route.

david: Tests: fuzz harness that simulates preemption+reconnect+interleaved confirms; unit tests for ledger CAS; e2e that asserts invoice shows single line after grouping.

mike: Backfill: we can attempt to heuristically group historical rows by session + short time window and tag a `backfill_handoff` where confident. Add GH ticket for manual audit for ambiguous cases.

elaine: Owners: runtime=mike, ledger=david, console=frank. I'll schedule a 30m follow-up Tue 09:30 to review canary telemetry.

mike: ack runtime owner.

david: ack ledger owner.

frank: ack console owner.

console-bot: Created GH issue rwd/infra#5100 (x-handoff + tombstone + console grouping) and INC-2026-1995 linked.

elaine: Thanks all — I'll update the incident and add acceptance criteria (metrics + e2e) to the GH issue.
